(Image: IIM Indore/Wikimediacommons) The Indian Institute of Management Indore (IIM Indore) has postponed the CAT admit card 2026 release date. IIM Indore will issue Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026 admit card on November 6. Also, CAT 2026 mock test with sample questions will be available on the CAT website starting from November 6.

 The CAT 2026 admit card will be issued on the official website, iimcat.ac.in. Candidates will have to enter their login details, such as user ID and password to access the IIM CAT 2026 admit card. 
 The management institute will conduct the CAT 2026 exam on November 29 in three shifts for admission to MBA and management courses at IIMs and other b-schools across the country. 
 IIM Indore will conduct the first shift of the CAT 2026 examination from 8:30 am to 10:30 am, second shift from 12:30 pm to 2:30 pm, and the third shift from 4:30 pm to 6:30 pm.
 Also read CAT 2026: Good score, percentile for top MBA colleges in India 
 CAT Admit Card Release Date and Time 2027
 CAT admit card 2026 release date has been revised by IIM Indore. CAT admit card 2026 will be issued on November 6. 
 Usually CAT admit card 2026 is issued before noon, by the exam conducting body.  Admit card is a mandatory document to be carried while appearing for the CAT 2026 MBA entrance exam. 
 CAT 2026 Admit Card Link
 IIM Indore will issue CAT admit card 2026 on its official website at iimcat.ac.in. Candidates will be able to download the hall ticket through login portal using details such as ser ID and password. 
 Candidates will find thier name, application number. category, date of birth. test city, reporting time, gate closing time, instructions and other important details on the CAT hall ticket 2026. 
 CAT 2026 score validity
 Those who will appear for the CAT 2026 examination, their scores will remain valid until December 31, 2027. 
 Each IIM will admit MBA aspirants as per its own admission rules and selection process. The criteria for admission will include academic requirements, minimum marks, and weightage for various factors. 
 Notably, candidates’ CAT 2026 scores will hold an important part in the management admission. However, IIMs may also consider Class 10 and 12 marks, graduation scores, work experience, and other factors while selecting candidates for the next stages.
 Also read Where are the bank jobs? Finance still hiring, just not where commerce graduates are looking 
 CAT 2026: How to download admit card?
 Candidates will be able to download the CAT 2026 admit card by following the steps given below.
 Go to the official website at iimcat.ac.in.
 On the homepage, click on the CAT 2026 admit card.
 Enter login details such as user ID and password.
 Click on the submit icon.
 CAT 2026 exam hall ticket will appear on the screen.
 Check details and download.
 CAT 2026 question paper will have 68 questions and divided into three sections such as Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension (VARC), Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning (DILR), and Quantitative Ability (QA).
 As per the marking scheme, candidates will be awarded three marks, and one mark will be deducted for each wrong response.
